newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends softer on stop-loss orders.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends softer on stop-loss orders.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar lost much of its strength Wednesday to close weaker C$1.3533 (US$0.7390) from Tuesday's close at C$1.3500 (US$0.7408) in fairly heavy volume, dealers said. * Most of the weakness stemmed from an interest to buy U.S. dollars and stop-loss orders kicking in, dealers said. * Traders expected more weakness on Thursday.
"Traditionally December is a month when the Canadian dollar tends to be weaker" as corporations settle their books and repatriate profits for year end, he said.
The currency was expected to test C$1.3575 (US$0.7367) in the next few days.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar held steady at about 1.1522 marks and slipped to 83.48 yen from Tuesday's close at 83.85 yen.
